history.status: release; ISO CI-built from the tag, QEMU-gated, booted on an HP Pavilion 2026-10-26
history.summary: LIVE look and status strip on every Cockpit tab, a full Network tab (interfaces, protocol traffic, WireGuard VPNs, bounded capture to Wireshark), fixed and themed app icons, and an orionx-logquery that never waits silently.

history.status: source tag; ISO CI-built from the tag and gated, release assets never staged (runner lacked xorriso) — superseded by v3.1.2
history.summary: Security update: a Debian security floor table enforced at every release boundary (PHP2Shell, Node2Shell/Brotli, kernel CVE-2026-98432 with boot-payload binding, firefox-esr DSA-6590-1, Zeek 9.0.1, OpenSSL, curl, Expat, xz, Wireshark, BIND, Unbound), plus the HP Pavilion fixes: brightness keys and power manager, volume and battery panel widgets, spoken-alert fallback and pronunciation, Cockpit click to the Attack Map.

history.status: release; ISO built, gated, split and signed by CI from the tag
history.summary: Release pipeline patch on v3.1.1: the tag run installs xorriso and squashfs-tools before signed staging, so the draft GitHub Release with split, signed assets comes from CI alone; User Guide version slots; QEMU boot-flake diagnostics (bounded plymouth quit, OnFailure kmsg dump, harness prints the block) for the intermittent login-prompt failure in either firmware mode (#141).
